column1: # The T-0204 CI query set: kind, brand and wording.
# Query, the expected primary name in the top `limit` (* = any), the expected
# exact kinds (| separated; empty = any), the expected brand (empty = any), and
# the result limit. The test computes found/probes and fails on any miss.
# It runs on the committed Lviv city search section
# Geofabrik snapshot recorded in tools/pipeline/README.md. A miss means the
# reader regressed, not that the data changed silently: the coordinates and
# rows are fixed by the committed fixture.
# Source of each group: the acceptance criterion (kind, brand, wording), and
# near-misses where a name already says the word the synonym table adds.
